description: Use when an agent needs all public holidays of a country for a year (planning deliveries, payments, deadlines, staffing). 247 countries, 2026-2028, optional state/province (region=) for regional holidays. English and local names, weekend days of the country, moon-dependent dates flagged as estimated. Bad input: HTTP 400 before payment, no charge. Price: 0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

country.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. AT, DE, US, GB, FR, JP, IN, BR, AE. 247 countries; free list: GET /v1/holiday-countries.

region.description: Optional state/province for regional holidays, e.g. BY or DE-BY (Bavaria), CA (California), 9 (Vienna). Listed per country in GET /v1/holiday-countries.

year.description: Year, e.g. 2027. Optional, default: current year. Covered: 2026-2028.

name: public_holidays
title: Public Holidays & Business Days
